name: seed and choco chip cookies
ingredients_raw: Atta, Hydrogenated Vegetable Fat, Refined Sugar, Dark Chocolate Chips (11.4%) [Sugar, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (Vanaspati), Maltodextrin, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin) (INS 322), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Vanillin), lodised Salt], Pumpkin Seeds (6.7%), Sunflower Seeds (6.7%), Cashewnuts (6.03%), Corn Flour, Orange Peel, Dextrose, Skimmed Milk Powder, Nature Identical Flavour (Orange), Artificial Flavour (Vanilla), Raising Agent [INS 503 (ii), INS 521, INS 500 (ii)], lodised Salt.
